en.text: He commanded the steward of his house, saying, “Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put each man’s money in his sack’s mouth.

zhSimplified.text: 吩咐家宰说：「把粮食装满这些人的口袋，尽着他们的驴所能驮的，又把各人的银子放在各人的口袋里，

zhTraditional.text: 吩咐家宰說：「把糧食裝滿這些人的口袋，儘着他們的驢所能馱的，又把各人的銀子放在各人的口袋裏，

en.text: Put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, with his grain money.” He did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

zhSimplified.text: 并将我的银杯和那少年人籴粮的银子一同装在他的口袋里。」家宰就照所说的话行了；

zhTraditional.text: 並將我的銀杯和那少年人糴糧的銀子一同裝在他的口袋裏。」家宰就照所說的話行了；

en.text: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their donkeys.

zhSimplified.text: 天一亮就打发那些人带着驴走了。

zhTraditional.text: 天一亮就打發那些人帶着驢走了。

en.text: When they had gone out of the city, and were not yet far off, Joseph said to his steward, “Up, follow after the men. When you overtake them, ask them, ‘Why have you rewarded evil for good?

zhSimplified.text: 他们出城走了不远，对家宰说：「起来，追那些人去，追上了就对他们说：『你们为什么以恶报善呢？

zhTraditional.text: 他們出城走了不遠，對家宰說：「起來，追那些人去，追上了就對他們說：『你們為甚麼以惡報善呢？

en.text: Isn’t this that from which my lord drinks, and by which he indeed divines? You have done evil in so doing.’”

zhSimplified.text: 这不是我主人饮酒的杯吗？岂不是他占卜用的吗？你们这样行是作恶了。』」

zhTraditional.text: 這不是我主人飲酒的杯嗎？豈不是他占卜用的嗎？你們這樣行是作惡了。』」

en.text: He overtook them, and he spoke these words to them.

zhSimplified.text: 家宰追上他们，将这些话对他们说了。

zhTraditional.text: 家宰追上他們，將這些話對他們說了。

en.text: They said to him, “Why does my lord speak such words as these? Far be it from your servants that they should do such a thing!

zhSimplified.text: 他们回答说：「我主为什么说这样的话呢？你仆人断不能做这样的事。

zhTraditional.text: 他們回答說：「我主為甚麼說這樣的話呢？你僕人斷不能做這樣的事。

en.text: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again to you out of the land of Canaan. How then should we steal silver or gold out of your lord’s house?

zhSimplified.text: 你看，我们从前在口袋里所见的银子，尚且从地带来还你，我们怎能从你主人家里偷窃金银呢？

zhTraditional.text: 你看，我們從前在口袋裏所見的銀子，尚且從地帶來還你，我們怎能從你主人家裏偷竊金銀呢？

en.text: With whomever of your servants it is found, let him die, and we also will be my lord’s slaves.”

zhSimplified.text: 你仆人中无论在谁那里搜出来，就叫他死，我们也作我主的奴仆。」

zhTraditional.text: 你僕人中無論在誰那裏搜出來，就叫他死，我們也作我主的奴僕。」

en.text: He said, “Now also let it be according to your words. He with whom it is found will be my slave; and you will be blameless.”

zhSimplified.text: 家宰说：「现在就照你们的话行吧！在谁那里搜出来，谁就作我的奴仆；其余的都没有罪。」

zhTraditional.text: 家宰說：「現在就照你們的話行吧！在誰那裏搜出來，誰就作我的奴僕；其餘的都沒有罪。」

en.text: Then they hurried, and each man took his sack down to the ground, and each man opened his sack.

zhSimplified.text: 于是他们各人急忙把口袋卸在地上，各人打开口袋。

zhTraditional.text: 於是他們各人急忙把口袋卸在地下，各人打開口袋。

en.text: He searched, beginning with the oldest, and ending at the youngest. The cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.

zhSimplified.text: 家宰就搜查，从年长的起到年幼的为止，那杯竟在的口袋里搜出来。

zhTraditional.text: 家宰就搜查，從年長的起到年幼的為止，那杯竟在的口袋裏搜出來。

en.text: Then they tore their clothes, and each man loaded his donkey, and returned to the city.

zhSimplified.text: 他们就撕裂衣服，各人把驮子抬在驴上，回城去了。

zhTraditional.text: 他們就撕裂衣服，各人把馱子抬在驢上，回城去了。

en.text: Judah and his brothers came to Joseph’s house, and he was still there. They fell on the ground before him.

zhSimplified.text: 和他弟兄们来到的屋中，还在那里，他们就在他面前俯伏于地。

zhTraditional.text: 和他弟兄們來到的屋中，還在那裏，他們就在他面前俯伏於地。

en.text: Joseph said to them, “What deed is this that you have done? Don’t you know that such a man as I can indeed do divination?”

zhSimplified.text: 对他们说：「你们做的是什么事呢？你们岂不知像我这样的人必能占卜吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 對他們說：「你們做的是甚麼事呢？你們豈不知像我這樣的人必能占卜嗎？」

en.text: Judah said, “What will we tell my lord? What will we speak? How will we clear ourselves? God has found out the iniquity of your servants. Behold, we are my lord’s slaves, both we and he also in whose hand the cup is found.”

zhSimplified.text: 说：「我们对我主说什么呢？还有什么话可说呢？我们怎能自己表白出来呢？ 神已经查出仆人的罪孽了。我们与那在他手中搜出杯来的都是我主的奴仆。」

zhTraditional.text: 說：「我們對我主說甚麼呢？還有甚麼話可說呢？我們怎能自己表白出來呢？上帝已經查出僕人的罪孽了。我們與那在他手中搜出杯來的都是我主的奴僕。」

en.text: He said, “Far be it from me that I should do so. The man in whose hand the cup is found, he will be my slave; but as for you, go up in peace to your father.”

zhSimplified.text: 说：「我断不能这样行！在谁的手中搜出杯来，谁就作我的奴仆；至于你们，可以平平安安地上你们父亲那里去。」

zhTraditional.text: 說：「我斷不能這樣行！在誰的手中搜出杯來，誰就作我的奴僕；至於你們，可以平平安安地上你們父親那裏去。」

en.text: Then Judah came near to him, and said, “Oh, my lord, please let your servant speak a word in my lord’s ears, and don’t let your anger burn against your servant; for you are even as Pharaoh.

zhSimplified.text: 挨近他，说：「我主啊，求你容仆人说一句话给我主听，不要向仆人发烈怒，因为你如同法老一样。

zhTraditional.text: 挨近他，說：「我主啊，求你容僕人說一句話給我主聽，不要向僕人發烈怒，因為你如同法老一樣。

en.text: My lord asked his servants, saying, ‘Have you a father, or a brother?’

zhSimplified.text: 我主曾问仆人们说：『你们有父亲有兄弟没有？』

zhTraditional.text: 我主曾問僕人們說：『你們有父親有兄弟沒有？』

en.text: We said to my lord, ‘We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother; and his father loves him.’

zhSimplified.text: 我们对我主说：『我们有父亲，已经年老，还有他老年所生的一个小孩子。他哥哥死了，他母亲只撇下他一人，他父亲疼爱他。』

zhTraditional.text: 我們對我主說：『我們有父親，已經年老，還有他老年所生的一個小孩子。他哥哥死了，他母親只撇下他一人，他父親疼愛他。』

en.text: You said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me, that I may set my eyes on him.’

zhSimplified.text: 你对仆人说：『把他带到我这里来，叫我亲眼看看他。』

zhTraditional.text: 你對僕人說：『把他帶到我這裏來，叫我親眼看看他。』

en.text: We said to my lord, ‘The boy can’t leave his father, for if he should leave his father, his father would die.’

zhSimplified.text: 我们对我主说：『童子不能离开他父亲，若是离开，他父亲必死。』

zhTraditional.text: 我們對我主說：『童子不能離開他父親，若是離開，他父親必死。』

en.text: You said to your servants, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you will see my face no more.’

zhSimplified.text: 你对仆人说：『你们的小兄弟若不与你们一同下来，你们就不得再见我的面。』

zhTraditional.text: 你對僕人說：『你們的小兄弟若不與你們一同下來，你們就不得再見我的面。』

en.text: When we came up to your servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

zhSimplified.text: 我们上到你仆人—我们父亲那里，就把我主的话告诉了他。

zhTraditional.text: 我們上到你僕人－我們父親那裏，就把我主的話告訴了他。

en.text: Our father said, ‘Go again and buy us a little food.’

zhSimplified.text: 我们的父亲说：『你们再去给我籴些粮来。』

zhTraditional.text: 我們的父親說：『你們再去給我糴些糧來。』

en.text: We said, ‘We can’t go down. If our youngest brother is with us, then we will go down: for we may not see the man’s face, unless our youngest brother is with us.’

zhSimplified.text: 我们就说：『我们不能下去。我们的小兄弟若和我们同往，我们就可以下去。因为，小兄弟若不与我们同往，我们必不得见那人的面。』

zhTraditional.text: 我們就說：『我們不能下去。我們的小兄弟若和我們同往，我們就可以下去。因為，小兄弟若不與我們同往，我們必不得見那人的面。』

en.text: Your servant, my father, said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons.

zhSimplified.text: 你仆人—我父亲对我们说：『你们知道我的妻子给我生了两个儿子。

zhTraditional.text: 你僕人－我父親對我們說：『你們知道我的妻子給我生了兩個兒子。

en.text: One went out from me, and I said, “Surely he is torn in pieces;” and I haven’t seen him since.

zhSimplified.text: 一个离开我出去了；我说他必是被撕碎了，直到如今我也没有见他。

zhTraditional.text: 一個離開我出去了；我說他必是被撕碎了，直到如今我也沒有見他。

en.text: If you take this one also from me, and harm happens to him, you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.’

footnotes.text: 44:29 Sheol is the place of the dead.

zhSimplified.text: 现在你们又要把这个带去离开我，倘若他遭害，那便是你们使我白发苍苍、悲悲惨惨地下阴间去了。』

zhTraditional.text: 現在你們又要把這個帶去離開我，倘若他遭害，那便是你們使我白髮蒼蒼、悲悲慘慘地下陰間去了。』

en.text: Now therefore when I come to your servant my father, and the boy is not with us; since his life is bound up in the boy’s life;

zhSimplified.text: 我父亲的命与这童子的命相连。如今我回到你仆人—我父亲那里，若没有童子与我们同在，

zhTraditional.text: 我父親的命與這童子的命相連。如今我回到你僕人－我父親那裏，若沒有童子與我們同在，

en.text: it will happen, when he sees that the boy is no more, that he will die. Your servants will bring down the gray hairs of your servant, our father, with sorrow to Sheol.

footnotes.text: 44:31 Sheol is the place of the dead.

zhSimplified.text: 我们的父亲见没有童子，他就必死。这便是我们使你仆人—我们的父亲白发苍苍、悲悲惨惨地下阴间去了。

zhTraditional.text: 我們的父親見沒有童子，他就必死。這便是我們使你僕人－我們的父親白髮蒼蒼、悲悲慘慘地下陰間去了。

en.text: For your servant became collateral for the boy to my father, saying, ‘If I don’t bring him to you, then I will bear the blame to my father forever.’

zhSimplified.text: 因为仆人曾向我父亲为这童子作保，说：『我若不带他回来交给父亲，我便在父亲面前永远担罪。』

zhTraditional.text: 因為僕人曾向我父親為這童子作保，說：『我若不帶他回來交給父親，我便在父親面前永遠擔罪。』

en.text: Now therefore, please let your servant stay instead of the boy, my lord’s slave; and let the boy go up with his brothers.

zhSimplified.text: 现在求你容仆人住下，替这童子作我主的奴仆，叫童子和他哥哥们一同上去。

zhTraditional.text: 現在求你容僕人住下，替這童子作我主的奴僕，叫童子和他哥哥們一同上去。

en.text: For how will I go up to my father, if the boy isn’t with me?—lest I see the evil that will come on my father.”

zhSimplified.text: 若童子不和我同去，我怎能上去见我父亲呢？恐怕我看见灾祸临到我父亲身上。」

zhTraditional.text: 若童子不和我同去，我怎能上去見我父親呢？恐怕我看見災禍臨到我父親身上。」
